name: Jaipur
tagline: A city built as a work of art.
description: Jaipur was planned in 1727 by Maharaja Jai Singh II with an architect's precision — the first planned city in modern India. Its pink walls were painted for the welcome of a British prince, and they stayed.

culture.title: The court tradition
culture.body: Jaipur's culture was shaped by royal patronage. The Kathak dance form, the Jaipur gharana of classical music, the tradition of miniature painting — all emerged from centuries of court life.

craft.title: Blue pottery and block prints
craft.body: Jaipur's blue pottery has Central Asian roots brought by Mughal craftsmen. Its block-printed textiles are made in workshops that have barely changed since the 17th century.

people.title: The merchant class
people.body: The Marwaris built Jaipur's commercial identity. Their havelis still stand in the old city, and their business networks stretch across the world.

memory.title: The astronomical city
memory.body: Jantar Mantar — the world's largest stone astronomical observatory — was built by Jai Singh to map the skies. It still keeps accurate time, daily.
